SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites.
   B. Treat Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites as rumours only.
   C. Say Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Location, Position and Size of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Location, Position and Size of Kenya.
   B. Explain Location, Position and Size of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Location, Position and Size of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Say Location, Position and Size of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

4. Which statement about The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui as rumours only.
   B. Say The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui.
   D. Explain The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Development of Transport is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Development of Transport as rumours only.
   B. Explain Development of Transport with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Development of Transport never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Development of Transport.

6. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries as rumours only.
   B. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries.
   D. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about School administration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain School administration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say School administration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing School administration.
   D. Treat School administration as rumours only.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

11. Which statement about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.

12. Which statement about African Traditional Education is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat African Traditional Education as rumours only.
   B. Say African Traditional Education never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing African Traditional Education.
   D. Explain African Traditional Education with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain School administration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Mining in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and Tourism in Kenya Sites Sceneries and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
